tools.name: peek_preview
tools.description: Get link-preview metadata for a public web page: title, description, OpenGraph image, site name, favicon, canonical URL. Fast and cheap — use this when you need to describe or card a link, not read it.

tools.name: peek_markdown
tools.description: Fetch a public web page and return its main content as clean Markdown, with navigation, scripts and styling stripped. Use this to actually read a page.
